title: Playlist Path Linter
smallest_useful_product: CLI that reads M3U/M3U8 plus a library root, resolves NFC/NFD variants, reports missing/ambiguous paths and invalid year/date tags, and emits an optional corrected copy plus JSON report.
constraints: Read-only by default; preserve encoding; never contact music services; test paths on case-sensitive and case-insensitive filesystems.
